sources.portals: every placed portal of the pinned world SQL v0.9.296 (ACE's open world database, not retail dats; cache/m6/4/world.sqlite, read offline with one read-only SELECT on 2026-11-17): SELECT l.guid, l.weenie_Class_Id, l.obj_Cell_Id, l.origin_X, l.origin_Y, l.origin_Z, COALESCE((SELECT s.value FROM weenie_properties_string s WHERE s.object_Id = l.weenie_Class_Id AND s.type = 1), '') AS name, COALESCE((SELECT p.obj_Cell_Id FROM weenie_properties_position p WHERE p.object_Id = l.weenie_Class_Id AND p.position_Type = 2), 0) AS dest_cell FROM landblock_instance l JOIN weenie w ON w.class_Id = l.weenie_Class_Id WHERE w.type = 7 (WeenieType.Portal) ORDER BY l.guid; origins rounded to 1 mm; dest_cell 0 is a portal with no stored Destination (PositionType 2)
sources.why: M6 14 (m6-14-plaza; live ladder62, 2026-11-17 16:29:41 UTC): the walk to the Yinar Portal's front in Samsur's portal plaza kept off its own portal alone and touched Sand's Edge Portal, which took her; every walk keeps off every placed portal near its line (RungPortal.AllKnown), and a hop names the portal that took her by its destination (WorldPortals.TakenBy)
